2.name: Welcome
2.overview: New residents mean building new homes. There's just one problem: regular houses do not fit the needs of minotaurs and centaurs.

2.name: New Residents
2.overview: A change of plans is in order. If the current village can't support the new residents, the solution is simple: build more villages.

2.name: Winter
2.overview: The Great Tree Village experiences another winter.

2.name: Martial Arts Competition
2.overview: What better way to mark a celebration than with a martial arts competition?

2.name: Another Peaceful Day
2.overview: From curing an illness to cultivating new crops to even Mountain Elves curating Hiraku’s favor, life in the Great Tree Village is never dull.

2.name: Fine Day for Vistors
2.overview: Hiraku has his hands full as mayor. Not only is he tasked with a series of angelic trials, but he must also mediate a draconic relationship.

2.name: Hot Spring Expedition
2.overview: A hot springs expedition quickly gets out of hand.

2.name: More Hot Spring Expedition
2.overview: They've dealt with the Lord of Death. Now they need to decide what to do with the black stones.

2.name: Return to Ordinary
2.overview: A feast celebrates the excavation of the black stones.

2.name: Festivities and Fuushu's Gratitude
2.overview: The passage of time brings change. A new competition is held, Alfred grows older, and new settlers arrive.

2.name: Castle in the Air
2.overview: The village must face a flying castle inhabited by demons.

2.name: A Village for All
2.overview: Hiraku establishes the newly powered Sun Castle as his fourth village. During a grand festival, he unveils a unifying flag while lightheartedly dodging pressure to take on a royal title.

overview: After Hiraku dies of a serious illness, God brings him back to life, gives his health and youth back, and sends him to a fantasy world of his choice. In order to enjoy his second shot, God bestows upon him the almighty farming tool! Watch as Hiraku digs, chops, and ploughs in another world in this laidback farming fantasy!

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: During the final years of his life, Hiraku Machio remained confined to a hospital bed with a terminal illness until he finally passed away. Taking pity on the unfair life he lived, a god decides to reincarnate Hiraku in another world where he can live as he pleases. Wanting to try farming in this new life, he is bestowed with an all-in-one "Almighty Farming Tool" that can transform into any useful implement he wishes. Hiraku is then transported to a forest seemingly far from civilization. Here, he plans to build and farm everything from scratch—gradually developing the lifeless area into a thriving new society.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Great Tree Village has grown far beyond the small farm Hiraku once built in the wilderness. As waves of new immigrants arrive seeking refuge, the village faces the challenges of rapid expansion, from housing diverse races such as minotaurs, centaurs, and forest spirits to managing new farmland, resources, and community needs. Between welcoming newcomers, hosting tournaments and festivals, exploring hot springs, and strengthening ties with neighboring powers, Hiraku's dream of a peaceful rural life becomes busier—and livelier—than ever. As the village continues to evolve into a thriving multicultural settlement, every day brings new faces, new projects, and new adventures.

title: Farming Life in Another World
